{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Mid-Michigan Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2024/november/mid-michigan-pipeline-completion-bolsters-natural-gas-reliability-across-five-counties|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Chelsea, Michigan to Ovid, Michigan.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us/Mpsc/ViewCommissionOrderDocument/25693|title=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|website=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wkar.org/post/utility-s-application-natural-gas-pipeline-approved|title=wkar.org|website=wkar.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Consumers Energy Co<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us/Mpsc/ViewCommissionOrderDocument/25693|title=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|website=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''56 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us/Mpsc/ViewCommissionOrderDocument/25693|title=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|website=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wkar.org/post/utility-s-application-natural-gas-pipeline-approved|title=wkar.org|website=wkar.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us/Mpsc/ViewCommissionOrderDocument/25693|title=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|website=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wkar.org/post/utility-s-application-natural-gas-pipeline-approved|title=wkar.org|website=wkar.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2024/november/mid-michigan-pipeline-completion-bolsters-natural-gas-reliability-across-five-counties|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2019<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us/Mpsc/ViewCommissionOrderDocument/25693|title=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|website=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Start year: '''2024<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2024/november/mid-michigan-pipeline-completion-bolsters-natural-gas-reliability-across-five-counties|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$550,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us/Mpsc/ViewCommissionOrderDocument/25693|title=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|website=adms.apps.lara.state.mi.us|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wkar.org/post/utility-s-application-natural-gas-pipeline-approved|title=wkar.org|website=wkar.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
